scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Establish one attributable durable receipt from approved review testimony

input.text: one approved human ownership-review transcription with exact case-level decisions

event.text: the governed ownership-review receipt is established

outcome.text: attributable durable ownership-review testimony preserves every exact case-level disposition, including every exact locally held case

scenarioSurface.notes:
An approved human ownership review must become attributable durable
  testimony without changing any exact case-level decision or allowing one
  locally held case to hold unrelated cases.
